paragraphs: The long-standing conflict in Yemen is intensifying as Houthi forces launch a major offensive against Saudi-backed government troops in the eastern province of Al Jawf.

Media released by the Houthi group shows extensive battlefield footage, including destroyed armored vehicles, heavy machine-gun fire from pickup trucks, and intense ground fighting across desert trenches.

Houthi forces claim to have inflicted heavy losses on government troops as their offensive gains momentum. In response, the Saudi-backed coalition has released aerial footage depicting retaliatory airstrikes aimed at stopping the Houthi advance and destroying military equipment.

As the violence spreads, innocent civilians bear the burden of the expanding war. Families are fleeing active battle zones on foot under heavy gunfire, and they often travel for days without food or water. Many displaced residents now arrive at makeshift camps outside Aden while the broader conflict continues to escalate.

paragraphs: Fighting in Yemen is getting worse as Houthi forces attack Saudi-backed government troops in the Al Jawf area. Houthi media showed videos of destroyed military trucks, rockets, and heavy fighting in the desert.

The Houthis say they killed many enemy soldiers and destroyed their weapons during several days of conflict. At the same time, the Saudi-backed government released air force pictures showing strikes against Houthi fighters and equipment to stop their advance.

Because of the heavy fighting and air attacks, many families escaped their homes. People walked at night without food or water while bullets flew around them. Many displaced families now live in simple tents in camps near Aden, and hope the dangerous conflict will stop soon.

paragraphs: The war in Yemen is getting very bad. Houthi fighters are attacking government soldiers in the desert. Videos show burning trucks, big guns, and explosions.

Houthi forces say that they are winning the fight. The Saudi-backed government is using planes to attack Houthi soldiers from the sky. Because of the dangerous fighting, many families must run away from their homes. People walk at night with no food, no water, and no money.
Now, many mothers, fathers, and children live in small tents in camps. They need help because the war is starting in new places.
